# vercel_shareable_link (Resource)

Manages a shareable link for an existing Vercel alias. Anyone with the link can bypass Deployment Protection for that alias. Ordinary deployment URLs without an alias record are not supported.

~> **Hobby plans:** Only one shareable link can exist per account. Creating a link automatically revokes other shareable links across the account, including links managed outside Terraform. Managing multiple links on a Hobby account will cause recurring drift.

The secret and URL are sensitive but are stored in Terraform state. Protect access to your state. Only one shareable link can exist per alias; import an existing link before managing it. Custom shareable-link parameters are not supported.

Changing ttl_seconds or rotation_id rotates the secret and immediately invalidates the old link. Expired links remain managed and are not automatically renewed. Create-before-destroy is not supported for the same alias.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vercel_shareable_link" "preview" {
  alias       = "my-project-git-staging.vercel.app"
  ttl_seconds = 604800
  rotation_id = "1"
}

output "preview_share_url" {
  value     = vercel_shareable_link.preview.url
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `alias` (String) The existing alias hostname, without a scheme or path.

### Optional

- `rotation_id` (String) Change this value to explicitly rotate the link, including renewing an expired link.
- `team_id` (String) The team ID. Defaults to the team configured in the provider.
- `ttl_seconds` (Number) How long a newly created or rotated link is valid, in seconds (1 to 63072000). Omit for no expiry. Changing this rotates the link.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the link has not expired, as of the last refresh.
- `created_at` (Number) Creation time in Unix milliseconds.
- `created_by` (String) The creator's ID.
- `expires_at` (Number) Expiry time in Unix seconds, or null for no expiry.
- `id` (String) The non-secret ID of the alias owning the link.
- `project_id` (String) The project owning the alias.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) The generated bearer secret. Stored in Terraform state.
- `url` (String, Sensitive) The HTTPS shareable URL, including the secret. Stored in Terraform state.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import using an alias hostname, optionally prefixed with the team ID.
terraform import vercel_shareable_link.preview my-project-git-staging.vercel.app
terraform import vercel_shareable_link.preview team_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx/my-project-git-staging.vercel.app
```
